description: Extract complete Unicode emoji sequences from text. Results group repeated emoji in first-occurrence order, and positions use UTF-16 code units with an exclusive end. Text is sent in the POST body.

deep.description: Include optional reference detail inside each result.

lang.description: Optional display language, such as fr or zh-Hant. IDs, numeric values and input parsing stay unchanged.

text.description: Text to inspect for native Unicode emoji, up to 16000 UTF-16 code units.

name: emoji_parse
title: Emoji Parse
